verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a search engine, since competitors such as Elasticsearch and Typesense can be self-hosted, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hosted or on-prem deployment option. The llms.txt describes Algolia as a platform providing hosted APIs, the docs say Algolia searches a copy of your data stored in its own indices, and community users cite its closed-source license as a reason to switch to self-hostable alternatives.
